title: CSS Definition: project stylesheet applied via class names
description: CSS Definition injects the stylesheet in its `style` parameter into the page — it has no output ports; its presence is its effect. Visual nodes opt in through their `cssClassName` input. Use it for what node parameters cannot express (pseudo-selectors, keyframe animations, media queries); prefer node style parameters for everything they can express, since the editor cannot inspect CSS effects.

parameters.style:
.pulse-banner { animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
@keyframes pulse { 0% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.6; } 100% { opacity: 1; } }
